rejection.userQuote: this is not the same design as what we originally requested - I assume only concept art in which this makes no sense to show in-game...
rejection.reason: The draft translates approved character concept art into a literal full-height illustration instead of the originally requested medium-proportioned 16-bit JRPG game sprite.
knownBlockingDefects: Style mismatch: literal detailed illustration does not follow the requested warm lower-resolution 16-bit JRPG game cutout treatment.
Viewpoint mismatch: full-height illustration presentation does not establish the elevated game viewpoint in the original sprite reference.
Detail mismatch: retained fine illustrative detail replaces deliberate readable clusters, clean contours and a simple expressive game-size face.
Proportion mismatch: the full-height illustrated figure does not follow the originally approved medium Avatar 1 sprite proportions.
